title: Cover federation facade peer boundaries, source reasons and argument rejection with fixtures
outcome: Fixture-only checks discriminate peer-count boundaries and preserve status-reason and argument-rejection behavior without network or process tests.
acceptance: Demonstrate a valid256-peer positive control and a257-peer rejection attributed to the peer-count limit.
Test empty-schema argument rejection without I/O and status200 with sourceLimit, invalidResponse and responseUnavailable passing unchanged to a null utilization roster.
Keep tests behavioral and fixture-only; no source/Markdown/instruction-file assertions or new network/process/sleep tests.
